source.basis: Quoted evidence supports the claim; its interpretation still needs current-source checks.

text: The importer rejects a selected non-directory whose fileSize exceeds 2147483647 before it calls _showItems. The large-ZIP test uses the sparse fixture but only waits until the error-notification box has a child. That checks a visible error path, not the exact oversized-ZIP error ID/text, the boundary at 2147483647, valid archive parsing or migrated profile data. No import or filesystem test ran.
title: The oversized-ZIP smoke test waits for a notification without checking the exact error
